summary.intent: Close the single verification gap in Phase 20 (Vault Migration) by generating gap-closure plans, then execute those plans to remove dead migration code from the API and clients.
summary.outcome: Two gap-closure plans were created (20-05 and 20-06), verified with full requirements coverage (6/6 REQ-IDs), and Wave 1 (API cleanup) was fully executed. Wave 2 (client cleanup) was spawned but the transcript ends before its completion is confirmed.

repo: Phase 20 (Vault Migration) is now canonical v2-blob-only — no non-migrated users exist, so all PATH B / DB fallback code is dead.
The vault entity previously stored `encrypted_root_folder_key`, `encrypted_root_ipns_private_key`, and `migrated_at` columns; these are now dropped — server is zero-knowledge.
The `POST /vault/migrate` endpoint and `migrateVault()` service method have been removed as of Wave 1 execution.
API client was regenerated after DTO simplification — downstream clients now see only `ownerPublicKey` and `rootIpnsName` on the vault type.
New web user vault init needs to publish a v2 blob from day one (Wave 2 task) to ensure rootFolderKey is IPFS-native.
Desktop Rust has non-migrated code paths (`InitVaultRequest` crypto fields, non-migrated branch in `fetch_and_decrypt_vault`) targeted for removal in Wave 2.
Recovery tool has null handling in export-file path that needs cleanup (Wave 2).
workflow: GSD gap closure mode (`--gaps-only`) skips research and reads VERIFICATION.md directly to scope planning.
Plans committed by the planner subagent are not re-committed by the orchestrator — orchestrator checks for existing commits before attempting its own.
Pre-wave dependency checks look for `key-links` in plan frontmatter; plans that embed links only in the body (not frontmatter) skip this check silently.
Spot-checks after each wave verify: SUMMARY.md exists, git commits present for that plan, and key created files exist on disk.

friction: Orchestrator attempted a redundant commit after plans were already committed by the planner agent — required extra bash calls to detect and skip.
Pre-wave key-link dependency check produced no signal because links were in the plan body rather than frontmatter, making the check a no-op.
open_items: Wave 2 (20-06) client cleanup execution was in progress at transcript end — completion and verification not confirmed.
Phase 20 verification and roadmap update (marking phase complete) not yet run — depends on Wave 2 completing successfully.
